7419873.name: Chabad of Golden
7419873.note: CrownHeights.info, 5 Aug 2026 ('New Shluchim to Golden, CO and the Colorado School of Mines'): 'Rabbi Yosef and Basya Stevenson, together with their daughters Chaya and Rivka, will be establishing Chabad of Golden and the Colorado School of Mines in time for the new school year'; 'until now there has been no permanent Jewish address for the community'; they came from a three-year internship at UW-Madison Chabad. Its chabad.org listing went up 22 July 2026.

2044349.name: The Jewish Life Center - Chabad Denver North
2044349.note: Chabad.org (Mindy Rubenstein) on CrownHeights.info, 15 Feb 2016 ('Jewish Life Takes Off at Former Airport in Denver Suburbs'): 'The Popacks moved to Stapleton, about 15 minutes northeast of downtown Denver, in March of 2013, and immediately started creating a Jewish niche there' (Rabbi Mendel and Estee Popack, co-directors of the Jewish Life Center-Chabad of Stapleton). Medium: its chabad.org listing went up 19 Nov 2012, a few months before the stated move.

6229550.name: Chabad of Steamboat Springs
6229550.note: Chabad.org (Uziel Scheiner) on CrownHeights.info, 21 May 2024 ('Mountains, Menorahs and a Man's Last Wish: The Story of the New Chabad of Steamboat Springs'): Rabbi Isaac and Chaya Abelsky 'are the first permanent Chabad emissaries to Steamboat Springs'; they came on 'an exploratory visit' in 'the summer of 2023'; 'Over the past year, the Abelskys have been back in Steamboat to run community-wide celebrations for Chanukah and Purim'; 'by Passover were able to hold both community Passover seders there' (in their new centre); 'Now, almost a year later, the Abelskys are making the final preparations for their move.' CrownHeights.info, 7 May 2024: they 'recently moved' there. The year is their first programmes as its shluchim (Chanukah 2023); its chabad.org listing went up 27 Dec 2023. Rabbi Abelsky had come before only as a rabbinical intern, for Chanukah 2018 and 2019.

582782.name: Chabad @ Auraria Campus
582782.note: No founding year found yet. A campus paper (Met Online) on CrownHeights.info, 23 Oct 2006 ('Jewish Mystery Machine Comes to Auraria'): 'The Chabad of Auraria, a campus Jewish student organization affiliated with the Chabad of Colorado, set up the van in celebration of the Jewish holiday of Sukkot' (Rabbi Yisrael-Moshe Ort), so it existed by Sukkot 2006. Its chabad.org listing went up 2007-10-19. Director: Yisrael Moshe Ort.
